sections.title: Minor Requirements
sections.note: At least 6 credits at or above the 3000 level 2000-level courses that count towards the minor include: ASTRO 2211 Astronomy: Stars, Galaxies, and Cosmology, ASTRO 2212 The Solar System: Planets, Small Bodies and New Worlds, ASTRO 2290 Relativity and Astrophysics, and ASTRO 2299 Search for Life in the Universe
